sources.title: CropCare AI - GitHub
sources.snippet: CropCare AI is a web application that helps farmers identify crop diseases by uploading leaf images. It uses a fine-tuned EfficientNetB4 model (transfer learning) to classify diseases across 9 crop types: Apple, Cherry, Corn, Grape, Peach, Pepper, Potato, Strawberry, and Tomato.
